---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for Falcraft
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem It Solves
What problem does this feature solve? Is your feature request related to a problem?
Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you'd like the feature to work.

## Example Usage
Show how you'd use this feature:
```
/fal <example command>
```

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Mockups/Examples
If applicable, add mockups, screenshots, or examples from other mods/games.

## Additional Context
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Implementation Ideas
If you have ideas about how this could be implemented technically, share them here (optional).

## Complexity Estimate
How complex do you think this feature would be to implement?
- [ ] Simple (a few hours)
- [ ] Medium (a few days)
- [ ] Complex (a week or more)
- [ ] Not sure
